page.overview:
What is Melias?

Melias is an anime-only town located in the Sandora Desert. Like Erumalu, it has become a ruin. Luffy, Vivi, Rasa, and Zaba went there to search for wood to repair the Barbar Pirates's ship. Rasa used to live there before the town went to ruin.
